overview.title: Soft sand and open sea views near town
overview.p1: Sfiha Beach (also written Asfiha) is a popular soft-sand beach located just south of Al Hoceima. It is favored by families and travelers looking for an easygoing sea day with open Mediterranean views directly facing the historic Peñón de Alhucemas islet.
overview.p2: Seasonal cafés, umbrella rentals, and basic beach amenities operate during the summer peak. Outside the main summer months, the stretch is quieter, making it ideal for peaceful seaside walks along the water.
overview.p3: Use Sfiha as a great alternative or second beach stop after Quemado, or make it your primary base if staying nearby.

q1.question: How does Sfiha Beach compare to Quemado Beach?
q1.answer: Sfiha Beach features fine, soft sand underfoot and sits slightly away from the urban centre, offering a more spacious feel compared to Quemado’s signature city-front location.

q2.question: What beach amenities are available at Sfiha?
q2.answer: Amenities are mostly seasonal (summer café kiosks, sunbeds, and parasols); bringing your own water and sun protection is recommended.

q3.question: Is Sfiha Beach suitable for children and families?
q3.answer: Yes, its shallow waters and soft sand make it very popular with families. Always observe local flag safety conditions when swimming.

q4.question: How do I get to Sfiha Beach from central Al Hoceima?
q4.answer: It is a short 10-minute taxi ride or drive along the main coastal route heading south from the town centre.

q5.question: When is the best season for swimming at Sfiha Beach?
q5.answer: Late spring through early autumn offers warm water temperatures and the best weather for full beach days.
